entity.summary: Smart-account and multisig wallet ecosystem that originated at Gnosis and was rebranded from Gnosis Safe to Safe in 2022.
entity.notes: Smart-account protocol and user interfaces are modeled as separate products.

products.summary: General-purpose smart account and multisig protocol introduced as Gnosis Safe.
Retail-focused Gnosis Safe mobile wallet launched in 2018 and later discontinued after minimal adoption.
products.notes: The exact discontinuation date is not fixed in the current source.

products.summary: Web interface lineage that followed the early retail mobile experiment and became the primary Gnosis Safe/Safe wallet interface.
products.notes: 2019 is approximate based on Safe history describing introduction a few months after the 2018 mobile product.

Current Safe Mobile app launch date is anchored to Safe Labs’ first-party 2025-10-16 announcement of the completely rebuilt Safe{Mobile} app for iOS and Android. This record remains distinct from the discontinued 2018 Gnosis Safe Mobile legacy product.

events.title: Gnosis Safe smart account introduced
events.description: Gnosis Safe was introduced in 2018 as a general-purpose smart account.

events.title: Retail-focused Gnosis Safe mobile wallet discontinued
events.description: Safe later described the 2018 retail-focused mobile wallet as discontinued because of minimal adoption.
events.notes: The source establishes the lifecycle but not a precise discontinuation date; 2019 is an approximate ordering anchor.

events.title: Gnosis Safe rebranded to Safe
events.description: The project rebranded from Gnosis Safe to Safe after spinning out from GnosisDAO; Safe states that the protocol, audited contracts, accounts, funds, and security model did not change.

events.title: Safe Labs launched the rebuilt Safe Mobile app
events.description: Safe Labs launched a completely rebuilt Safe{Mobile} application for managing and signing Safe smart-account transactions on iOS and Android.
events.notes: This event tracks the current rebuilt Safe Mobile product and does not rewrite the separate lifecycle of the discontinued 2018 Gnosis Safe Mobile legacy app.

events.title: Safe{Wallet} Web supply-chain compromise enabled targeted Bybit transaction manipulation
events.description: A targeted compromise of a Safe{Wallet} developer workstation and Safe{Wallet} web-delivery infrastructure enabled malicious JavaScript to manipulate a Bybit Safe transaction on 2025-02-21. The manipulated transaction resulted in approximately $1.46 billion in assets leaving Bybit's affected Ethereum cold wallet.
events.amount_text: Approximately $1.46 billion from Bybit's affected Ethereum cold wallet
events.notes: The product boundary is Safe{Wallet} Web. Safe stated that external forensic review did not identify vulnerabilities in Safe smart contracts or in the source code of the frontend/services. Sygnia describes the incident as a supply-chain compromise and traces the attack path from a compromised Safe developer workstation through Safe AWS access to injected JavaScript served from app.safe.global. The malicious code was highly targeted to the Bybit Safe; this record does not generalize the impact to all Safe accounts or Safe Mobile.

events.title: Safe{Wallet} rebuilt infrastructure and rotated credentials after targeted compromise
events.description: Safe reported that the Safe{Wallet} team fully rebuilt and reconfigured infrastructure, rotated all credentials, eliminated the identified attack vector, and restored Safe{Wallet} on Ethereum mainnet with a phased rollout and additional security measures.
events.notes: This remediation is infrastructure- and credential-based, so WLR does not invent an affected-version or fixed-version range. The 2025-02-28 date is the public disclosure date of the completed rebuild/credential-rotation boundary, not an asserted exact completion timestamp for every remediation action.

evidence.title: History of Safe
evidence.notes: Primary history source for 2018 Gnosis Safe, legacy mobile wallet, web product evolution and 2022 rebrand.

evidence.title: Safe Crypto Wallet App: Your assets. Your control.
evidence.notes: Primary source confirming current Safe Mobile availability and multisig wallet function.

evidence.title: Secure Signing, Now Seamlessly Mobile: Safe Labs Introduces An All-New Safe{Mobile} App
evidence.notes: First-party Safe announcement explicitly states Safe Labs launched the completely rebuilt Safe{Mobile} app and that it was available on both iOS and Android.

evidence.title: February 28th, 2025: Statement by the Safe Ecosystem Foundation
evidence.notes: Official Safe Ecosystem Foundation statement reproducing the Safe{Wallet} team's preliminary findings: compromised Safe{Wallet} developer machine, disguised malicious transaction, no identified Safe smart-contract or frontend/services source-code vulnerability, full infrastructure rebuild/reconfiguration, credential rotation and phased restoration.

evidence.title: Bybit – What We Know So Far
evidence.notes: Investigator-authored account documenting the compromised Safe developer workstation, stolen AWS access, malicious JavaScript injected into Safe{Wallet}'s S3-delivered web resources, the targeted Bybit activation condition and the conclusion that the incident traced back to a supply-chain compromise.

evidence.title: Bybit Security Incident: Timeline of Events and FAQs
evidence.notes: First-party victim timeline establishing the 2025-02-21 incident, approximately $1.46B asset loss from the affected Ethereum cold wallet, Safe's temporary Wallet pause, and the later forensic finding of malicious JavaScript on the Safe{Wallet} platform.
